reason: Every 3rd frame of the 45 s chase was scored. Three frames are still over 1.8, so there is no film.
scan: every 3rd frame, t = 1 + i/30, 450 samples. Every frame was then scored from t=4.80-5.60 and t=11.20-12.20.

diagnosis.heading: steady, about 6.5 degrees, yaw rate 0 at the old spikes
diagnosis.pitch: -5 to -8 degrees. At t=11 and t=26 the eye drops (0.54 m, 0.27 m) because the ground under the camera is low.
diagnosis.bolt: centred, lat 0. The shadow and the paw puffs sit inside the mask. Flat albedo passes the old spikes, so flakes and the shadow are not the column.
diagnosis.mix: Weights are world position, not time. At t=11 one still reached 0.67 on the shoulder. At t=26 the mix was even (max 0.42) and the old spike was 1.894, so a single still was not the only cause. The gate band is the snow inside about 4 m, where a 0.5 m tile is 80-140 px, and that tile was in phase across the lane.

fix: Kept the one heading. Added a second slow mix axis across the lane, a floor so one still stays under about 0.45, a few centimetres of shift per still, and a 6 m macro from the same stills.

snowColour.lift: snow albedo response vec3(1.64, 1.74, 1.90). Ice and the sky keep the dawn rig. No fog.
